title: Fisheries Bihar – मछली पालन योजनाएँ और आवेदन
organization: Department of Fisheries, Government of Bihar
vacancyDetails: State and central fisheries schemes, aquaculture support and online application information for Bihar.
qualification: Fish farmers, entrepreneurs and beneficiaries meeting the conditions of the relevant fisheries scheme.
ageLimit: As per the concerned fisheries scheme.
selectionProcess: Scheme registration -> Document verification -> Approval -> Assistance / subsidy
documentsRequired: Aadhaar, bank details, residence proof, fishery or land details and scheme-specific documents.
howToApply: Open the official Fisheries Bihar portal, review the available scheme and follow its registration and application instructions.
shortDescription: Fisheries Bihar portal for मछली पालन की राज्य और केंद्रीय योजनाएँ तथा applications.
content:
The Fisheries Bihar portal provides information about state and central fisheries schemes, aquaculture support and applications.

Fish farmers and eligible entrepreneurs can review pond, fisheries, training and assistance programmes available through Bihar departments.

Applicants should check the official scheme guidelines for eligibility, documents, district availability and application timelines before submitting details.
